title: Positive multiplication is nonzero in characteristic zero
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero with decidable equality, and let W be a Weierstrass curve over k with W.Δ ≠ 0. For every natural number n > 0, there exists P : W.toAffine.Point such that n • P ≠ 0, using the usual point-group operation and identity.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ P : W.toAffine.Point, n • P ≠ 0
